mentions.author: mminer237
mentions.story: The Great Cannon has been deployed again
mentions.text: I suppose I probably overstated the situation a bit. The PRC National Intelligence Law ( [course]) requires, "Any organization or citizen shall support, assist and cooperate with the state intelligence work...", and China was observed making its own certificates for foreign sites before this ( [link]), but there's no direct evidence that China actually has all the root certificates currently or has used them maliciously. Of course, the law requires citizens to preserve secrecy and Westerners can't observe what China is doing, so that wouldn't be unexpected.
